# Angelica Dornton

> Portfolio of Angelica Dornton, a web developer and designer. She builds and deploys full-stack web apps and designs interfaces with a focus on typography, layout, and color. Open to internships and freelance work.

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://eliutot.github.io/): About, work, current projects, and contact details.

## Elsewhere

- [GitHub](https://github.com/eliutot): Source code for projects.
- [Behance](https://www.behance.net/angelicadornton): Visual and design work.
- [Figma](https://www.figma.com/@dornton): UI design.
